releases.name: v2.0.2 (Jul 29, 2026)
releases.body:
## Minor Bugfix

Convert all kwargs (such as sigma) of the GaussianFilterOperator to python native (e.g. list of floats for sigma).
E.g., enables passing of torch tensors for sigma.

releases.name: v2.0.1 (Jul 24, 2026)
releases.body:
## Bug fix


- **``GaussianFilterOperator`` now works with PyTorch (and array-api-strict) CPU
  arrays under modern scipy.** The CPU path previously passed the input array
  straight to ``scipy.ndimage.gaussian_filter``; with array-API-aware scipy
  (``SCIPY_ARRAY_API`` / scipy ≥ 1.16) this made scipy compute natively in the
  input's namespace, where ``gaussian_filter1d`` reverses the kernel with a
  negative-step slice (``weights[::-1]``) that PyTorch does not support. The
  operator now filters on a NumPy view (zero-copy on CPU) and converts back, so
  it is robust regardless of the scipy version or ``SCIPY_ARRAY_API``. This
  fixes downstream use via e.g. DeepInv.

releases.name: v2.0.0 (Jul 17, 2026)
releases.body:
Major v2.0.0 release including many new features but also a few minor breaking changes.
Please see our [changelog](https://github.com/KUL-recon-lab/parallelproj/blob/main/docs/changelog.rst) for details.

releases.name: v1.10.2 (Aug 20, 2025)
releases.body:
## summary of changes
- add compatibility for latest cupy version (>= 13.5) which require `from_dlpack` to convert
from torch tensors
- fix minor issues to be compatible with `array-api-strict~=2.0`

## merged PRs
* update binder postbuild by @gschramm in https://github.com/gschramm/parallelproj/pull/110
* remove pdm by @gschramm in https://github.com/gschramm/parallelproj/pull/111
* add gradient field projection operator by @gschramm in https://github.com/gschramm/parallelproj/pull/112
* WIP example that shows how to implement a gradient descent layer by @gschramm in https://github.com/gschramm/parallelproj/pull/113
* restrict cupy version in install instructions by @gschramm in https://github.com/gschramm/parallelproj/pull/117
* fix incompatibilities with new cupy version (13.5) by @gschramm in https://github.com/gschramm/parallelproj/pull/118
* bump version and update changelog by @gschramm in https://github.com/gschramm/parallelproj/pull/119


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/gschramm/parallelproj/compare/v1.10.1...v1.10.2

releases.name: v1.6.0
releases.body:
## Changelog vs v1.5.0

**Changes to the LinearOperator abstract base class break backward compatibility**

**C/CUDA libraries + API were not changed**

Changes to the python API:
- rewrite LinearOperator base class + basic operators to support python array api including different devices
- add missing type hints
- add finite difference operator
- remove obsolete functions

releases.name: v1.5
releases.body:
## Changelog vs v1.4

- add compatibility of python wrapper to python array api (via array-api-compat) such that numpy, cupy, pytorch arrays can be directly projected using the python wrappers
- a few small breaking changes in the python wrappers to the projectors, **but no changes to the C/CUDA libs**
- update of the python tests and examples
